producer_contract.name: event
producer_contract.description:
Tagged-primary-v5. Emit this string on EVERY latest reply, including unknown. Current phase {{phase}}; call calendar {{now}}; called person {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. Only describe the latest turn, never cached facts. Output only tagged rows, not JSON or sibling fields.
Grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;optional KEY=VALUE;END. Multiple rows use one newline; no trailing newline. Required k,c. Keys: p product ID/type/label; a completed positive decimal with at most two fractional digits; d complete verbatim date; v requested complete security answer; t HH:MM; u unfinished component amount/date/both/unknown. No empty, duplicate or unknown keys. Values contain only ASCII letters/digits/spaces/underscore/comma/period/slash/colon/hyphen. No escaping; unrepresentable input is unknown. c=1 means complete positive current assertion, never quoted, hypothetical, negated or third-party facts. c=0 means genuinely unfinished; payment corrections require u, with only independently completed a/d retained. Complete rows omit u. Dates include ISO, day/month/year, today/tomorrow, this/next weekday, month words and ordinals with optional year, weekday plus ordinal, and day-only ordinal referring to the current offer. Next weekday is in following calendar week; this weekday is current week. Preserve wording for deterministic checking.
Kinds and literal examples, one valid output per line:
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=third_party;c=1;END
k=wrong_number;c=1;END
k=deceased;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=0123;END
k=decline;c=1;END
k=purpose;c=1;END
k=agree;c=1;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;END
k=too_much;c=1;END
k=vague;c=1;END
k=paid;c=1;END
k=dispute;c=1;END
k=hardship;c=1;END
k=plan;c=1;END
k=human;c=1;END
k=stop;c=1;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=unknown;c=1;END
k=question;c=1;END
k=change;c=0;u=date;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;d=November second;END
k=proposal;c=0;u=amount;d=this Friday;END
k=security;c=0;END
Recipient phase: yes/thats me/speaking/current own name confirms recipient only, including greeting/title; hello alone unknown. Generic confirm is also valid here. DOB/phone phases: security v is the complete requested birth date including year or all four phone digits, preserving leading zero; numerical DOB is day/month/year. Introductory words are excluded from v. A complete answer accompanied by an independent question stays security; an unfinished year/digit group stays c=0, never completed from question numbers. Offer yes is agree to exact spoken terms; readback yes is fresh confirm only for that current readback. Yes with changed terms is proposal; qualified/withdrawn permission is change, never confirm. Yes no problem is affirmative. Payment date/amount alone is proposal, never refusal; vague period is vague. Current arrears already paid is paid; historical closed/paid off is dispute. Customer hardship outranks plan/refusal, retaining voluntary a/d. Lower instalments/new plan is plan; actual human request is human, AI question is question. Relative offering payment is third_party. In support phase no is decline. Independent questions do not erase primary facts. Separate completed amount/date rows may complete one target; never copy old terms as new facts.

Preserve questions accompanying a complete or unfinished primary answer, regardless of comma, semicolon or and. Output only these flags.
